faq.q: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a: Use the appointment form on the Contact page, call the clinic, or message us on Telegram. We will confirm your time with you.
We are open Monday to Saturday, 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM, and closed on Sundays.
We are in the Abyssinia Building, 4th floor, Bole Medhanialem, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.
Yes. Our pediatric service covers fillings, cleanings and baby tooth extraction, and kids braces are available.

faq.q: What should I do in a dental emergency?
faq.a: Call the clinic straight away. For a knocked-out tooth, keep the tooth moist and get to the clinic as quickly as you can.

story: Dr. Ferhana Adem, an expert dental surgeon, founded Dalian Dental Clinic. Over time she has built a team of specialists who share one approach: listen first, explain clearly, and treat every patient with care.
mission: To give every patient safe, honest and comfortable dental care.
vision: To be a dental clinic in Addis Ababa that patients trust for the whole family.
